translations.web: Yahweh, God of Armies, who is a mighty one, like you? Yah, your faithfulness is around you.
translations.bsb: O LORD God of Hosts, who is like You? O mighty LORD, Your faithfulness surrounds You.
translations.kjv: O LORD God of hosts, who is a strong LORD like unto thee? or to thy faithfulness round about
translations.asv: O Jehovah God of hosts, Who is a mighty one, like unto thee, O Jehovah? And thy faithfulness is round about thee.
